FAQ

Should I stake/unstake or swap?

Stake: no slippage, no capacity limits, instant, adjustment rate applied.

Unstake: no slippage, no capacity limits, requires ~4 days, no fees. See docs: Unstake Lifecycle.

Swap (buy or sell): slippage, instant, swap fees, available at multiple venues. See: Swap Venues.

Is there a minimum stake/unstake amount?

The minimum stake amount is 0.02 ETH, and the minimum unstake amount is 0.01 ETH. For amounts smaller than the above, see available CEXs and DEXs on the Explore page.

Where do I find more information?

See the latest tutorial: mantle blog
